top module named arbiter. Any helper modules must be included in the same block,
instantiated by this circuit, and uniquely named. Do not include a testbench or
another independent circuit. Implement the specified interface and behavior.

                "If ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN is not set, use fixed_priority to determine the next grant.",

                "Set grant_encoded to the index of the currently granted request.",
                "Update current_grant and round_robin_counter based on the evaluated requests and priority type."
            ]
        }
    ]

    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
